# ShapeHaven Innovations

> ShapeHaven Innovations is a research and software lab. We chase good problems, then build iOS and web apps to solve them. Products: ReturnIQ, CondoGuard, KavaCrawl, mDNSShark, and RhythmX.

ShapeHaven Innovations LLC is a small, independent team. Some apps are open source, some are closed source, and some show ads that can be removed with a purchase. We collect only what an app needs to work.

## Products

- [ReturnIQ](https://returniq.shapehaveninnovations.com/) - Shopify app for AI-powered returns management and analytics, helping merchants cut loss and streamline logistics.
- [CondoGuard](https://condoguard.app/) - property and condo management app for boards, owners, and residents.
- [KavaCrawl](https://kavacrawl.app/) - social app for discovering new places and people.
- [mDNSShark](https://mdnsshark.shapehaveninnovations.com/) - mDNS and Bonjour service discovery tool for finding and inspecting devices on a local network.
- [RhythmX](https://rhythmx.shapehaveninnovations.com/) - Private menstrual cycle tracker for iPhone. No account, no ads, no tracking.
- [RhythmX guide: How to track your cycle privately](https://rhythmx.shapehaveninnovations.com/guides/track-your-cycle-privately/) - four checks for any period tracker.
- [RhythmX reference: Menstrual cycle phases](https://rhythmx.shapehaveninnovations.com/guides/menstrual-cycle-phases-reference/) - timing, hormones, symptoms and tips per phase.
